senses.gloss: תֵּאֵר (denom. of תּוֹאַר) to shape; to give a fine appearance to, improve.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10<sup>10</sup></cite> <he>הגילוח מְתָאֲרוֹ ומייפהו</he> cutting his hair improves his appearance, and makes him handsome.—Part. pass. <he>מְתוֹאָר</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 11">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XI</cite> <he>היה מת׳ בדמות וכ׳</he> was formed in the image of God.
